_comment: Platform posting constraints. Update here — post_validator.py reads this at runtime.

_hashtag_selection_protocol._note: How agents pick hashtags for any post. Follow slot-fill order exactly.
slot_fill_order: 1. Brand tags — always first, in priority order. These build your owned highway over time. Never skip.
2. Campaign-specific tags — event or series tags relevant to THIS post (e.g. #ClawCamp, #AIInfraSummit). Include when the post is directly tied to that event/series.
3. Niche tags — most specific to the post topic, in priority order. Drives targeted discovery.
4. Highway tags — broadest reach, fill remaining slots, in priority order.

detector_protocol._note: Before campaign ship, run a live hashtag audit. Update priority scores in _hashtag_banks if materially stale.
steps: 1. For each candidate tag: search the platform, note posts-in-last-7-days.
2. Classify: >5000 recent posts = live highway; 200-5000 = active niche; <200 = dead road (skip unless brand-owned).
3. Rank within each category by engagement velocity (recent posts × estimated engagement rate).
4. Pick top N within platform max using slot-fill order above.
5. Log the audit result in the campaign-master surface coverage matrix with date.
detector_protocol.freshness: Re-run detector quarterly OR when a tag hasn't fired in 60+ days. Static lists decay.

never_do: Never pick randomly from the bank — always follow priority order.
Never exceed platform hashtag_max — spam classifier fires above limit.
Never put hashtags in body on LinkedIn — append at end of post only.
Never use a dead road tag (<200 recent posts) unless it's a brand tag you own.
Never put all slots in one category — always brand + at least one niche.

_hashtag_banks._note: Priority 1 = pick first. Within each category, pick descending by priority until platform max is filled. Update priority scores after detector runs.

brand.note: Primary personal brand — thesis tag. Always slot 1 for personal branding posts.
Personal brand handle tag. Add when post is profile-building (not just topic-specific).
Series brand for the 8-essay arc. Add when post is part of that series.
Product brand. Add only when post explicitly references xOS product vision.

niche.note: Highest-fit niche for AI sovereignty / whose-assistant-is-it angle.
Current hot niche — agentic systems, multi-agent loops.
Infrastructure angle — use for ClawCamp / technical posts.
Broader niche — employer AI / digital twin posts.

highway.note: Best-fit highway — leaders + AI audience overlap with Anand's ICP.
Current high-velocity highway. Use as primary fill when 1 highway slot open.
Classic broad highway. Large but competitive — use when 2 highway slots open.
Engineering leadership audience. Use for career/leadership-angle posts.

brand.note: Always slot 1. Builds brand highway on X.

niche.note: Best niche fit for X AI audience.

highway.note: Slot 2 highway on X when no niche tag fits. X highway works better with fewer, bigger tags.

linkedin_post.links_note: External links in post body are penalized by algorithm. Put in first comment.
linkedin_post.line_break_hook_note: First 3 lines visible before 'see more'. Hook must land there.
linkedin_post.max_blank_lines_note: More than 2 consecutive blank lines create jarring visual gaps in the feed.

linkedin_dm.max_blank_lines_note: Short message surface — multiple blank lines waste the 500-char limit.

linkedin_connection.max_blank_lines_note: Very short surface — blank lines waste the 300-char limit.

x_post.links_count_chars_note: URLs count as 23 chars regardless of actual length (t.co shortening).
x_post.max_blank_lines_note: Each blank line wastes 1 of your 280 chars.

instagram_caption.char_visible_note: Only first 125 chars visible before 'more'. Hook must land there.
instagram_caption.links_note: No clickable links in caption. Use 'link in bio'.

substack_post.send_to_subscribers_note: IRREVERSIBLE — once sent, a second publish triggers a second subscriber email.
substack_post.max_blank_lines_note: Excessive blank lines create ugly gaps in the rendered Substack layout.

reddit_post.promo_tone_note: Promotional tone triggers downvotes and mod removal. Lead with value, not pitch.

email_body.plain_text_note: Pipe characters, bold markers, and tables render as literal chars in most email clients.

whatsapp_message.plain_text_note: Markdown tables and pipe chars paste as literal bad characters.
